description.html: This water dish styled as porous grey stone has soft, rounded edges and a surface full of small pits, like volcanic rock or a river stone. The back is higher and rounded like a small rock, while the front is lower, so the water is easy to reach from the front.

The shape is designed for placing the dish against the back or side glass: the higher part blends naturally into the background or the rocks behind it, and your animal approaches the water from the lower side. The grey color is neutral and easy to combine with grey rocks, slate, 3D backgrounds and darker substrates.
It suits lizards and snakes that need a constant, easy-to-reach water supply.

Choose a dish your animal can drink from without climbing into it; young individuals prefer lower edges. Change the water every day. The pits on the surface trap dirt, so once a week clean the dish with a brush under warm water and rinse it well. See other dishes in our equipment range.
